_comment: The four reference sets for Part 2. Each one exists to stress a different axis of the
renderer, so they are not interchangeable and a capture is not 'done' because one of them
landed. Status is recorded per set and is the honest state, not the intent.

targets.why: 21 hidden layer plots that exist only as fill anchors, plus two moving averages and 22 colorer plots. The natural stress case for fills, hidden plots and per-band colour.

targets.lineMap: NOT WRITTEN YET — the 12 plots are captured in all four sets and have not been read.

targets.why: A control, not a target. Small and independently understood, which is why it was the one that exposed the inverted colorer index.

_target_naming: The build order names the targets 'Clouds' and 'Volume'. 'Clouds' is unambiguous. 'Volume'
was first read as the TradingView built-in and is more likely 'Uncharted Volume' — same author
as Clouds. Rather than guess, ALL THREE are captured side by side in every set, so whichever
reading is right, the data is already there.

sets.why: The baseline. Daily bars, a liquid symbol, enough history that no plot is inside its warmup.
A second symbol at the same timeframe, so a difference between A and B is about the DATA and never about the timeframe.
Weekly. Changes bar spacing and the time axis without changing the symbol, which is where x-coordinate and label-collision bugs surface.
sets.note: The final weekly bar equals set A's final daily bar exactly. That is correct: 2026-09-07 was Labor Day, so the week beginning then holds a single session so far.

sets.why: Intraday 4H. Sessions, gaps and a non-continuous time axis — the case where a renderer that assumes evenly spaced bars finally breaks.
sets.note: Five distinct gaps between consecutive bars in one 300-bar window: 14400s (the 4h step), 72000s (overnight), 244800s (a weekend), 331200s (a holiday weekend) and 241200s (a weekend exactly one hour short — a DST transition). This is the set that earns its place.

_outstanding: Uncharted Volume does not appear in any reference IMAGE. Its pane was allocated zero height on
the capture layout, and TradingView cannot recompute pane heights while the tab is
visibilityState:'hidden' — which it was for the whole session. The VALUES are unaffected
because they are read from the chart model, not from pixels. Re-shoot with the browser window
foregrounded and the images are complete.
No table or label crops exist because neither target draws a table or a label.
The built-in Volume's per-index palette (the two histogram hues) was not captured.
